description: This file defines the strategy and validation logic for managing Kubernetes IngressClass resources, including creation, update, and validation procedures.

classes.name: ingressClassStrategy
classes.description: Implements verification and validation logic for IngressClass resources, including creation, update, and normalization.

methods.name: NamespaceScoped
methods.description: Indicates that IngressClass is a non-namespaced resource.

methods.name: PrepareForCreate
methods.description: Initializes an IngressClass object before creation, setting its generation to 1.

methods.name: PrepareForUpdate
methods.description: Prepares an IngressClass object for update, incrementing the generation if the spec has changed.

methods.name: WarningsOnCreate
methods.description: Returns any warnings during creation; currently none.

methods.name: Canonicalize
methods.description: Normalizes the object after validation; currently a no-op.

methods.name: AllowCreateOnUpdate
methods.description: Indicates that creation on update is not allowed; POST is required.

methods.name: ValidateUpdate
methods.description: Validates updates to an existing IngressClass object.

methods.name: WarningsOnUpdate
methods.description: Returns any warnings during update; currently none.

methods.name: AllowUnconditionalUpdate
methods.description: Indicates that unconditional updates are permitted.
